children: Grayscale and investment platform Republic are offering three specialised crypto funds with minimum commitments starting at $2,500. The products remain restricted to eligible accredited investors.
Grayscale is opening another route into sector-specific cryptocurrency investing, reducing the minimum commitment for selected private funds through a distribution partnership with Republic.

The products focus on decentralised finance, artificial intelligence and blockchain data infrastructure. Eligible investors can gain exposure through managed vehicles rather than purchasing every underlying cryptocurrency themselves.

The $2,500 entry level is significantly lower than the sums typically associated with institutional private placements, but the offering should not be mistaken for a mass-market retail investment product.

Grayscale’s decentralised finance portfolio includes projects associated with lending, trading and other blockchain-based financial services. Its AI strategy covers networks involved in decentralised computing and related technology.
The partnership illustrates how asset managers are packaging more specialised cryptocurrency themes for investors who already understand conventional investment products.
Grayscale has separately explored staking-related changes to its Ethereum and Solana investment structures, reflecting its effort to develop products beyond straightforward token-price exposure.

Participation in the Republic offering is limited to accredited investors under applicable US securities rules. Private investment products may impose selling restrictions, and their holdings can be considerably less liquid than publicly traded ETFs.
The lower minimum also does nothing to eliminate the volatility of the cryptocurrencies inside each portfolio.
Still, the arrangement provides another example of how traditional asset managers are attempting to make a wider variety of digital assets accessible through familiar investment structures.
Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

title: Grayscale Opens DeFi And AI Crypto Funds To Investors With Just $2,500
